slides.texte_overlay:
the boring habits that
quietly changed my life

the same wake up time

i wake up at the same time every day, weekends included. it sounds dull, but my energy, mood and sleep changed more from this than from any supplement.

a glass of water first

i drink a full glass of water before coffee every morning. it's the most boring habit i have, and it quietly fixed the afternoon headaches i'd had for years.

the ten minute walk

i walk for ten minutes after lunch, every day, in any weather. that short walk clears my head better than a second coffee and quietly saves my afternoons.

one small lesson a day

i learn one small thing every day in 5 minutes: a word, a painting, a moment in history. boring on its own, but a year of it changed how i think and talk.

the sunday reset

every sunday evening i clean the kitchen and plan the week in twenty minutes. mondays stopped feeling like a crash and started feeling like a fresh start.
